run_write_top_k_vasp_relax: run the write_top_k_vasp script to generate VASP relaxation input files for the top k best adsorbate-slab configurations from a cache
run_write_top_k_vasp_single_point: run the write_top_k_vasp script with the --sp flag to generate VASP single point input files for top k configurations
create_vasp_input_files: create VASP input files for atomic structures using write_vasp_input_files with custom vasp_flags for ENCUT, EDIFFG, and GGA settings
load_mlrs_cache: load a pickled cache file from process_mlrs.py using safe_pickle_load to access ranked adsorbate-slab configurations
write_paths_list: write a paths_list.txt file containing all generated VASP input directories for batch job submission
